summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Skillful Craftsman Education Technology Limited reporting an amendment to a promissory note purchase agreement. The amendment extends the maturity date of $1,000,000 in 6% promissory notes held by insiders (major shareholder, director, and CEO) from March 31, 2026 to September 30, 2026. No new securities are issued, no change in terms other than the extension, and no special-situation event such as acquisition, restructuring, or tender offer is involved. This is a standard debt extension filing with no strategic implications for shareholders.
